title: Fixed by AI, Flagged as AI: code, detector scores and results site
description:
Code, per-essay detector scores and results website for the preprint Fixed by AI, Flagged as AI: A Matched Audit of AI-Text Detectors on 12,132 Student Essays (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23400778).

On the original TOEFL essays the result holds (43–97% flagged by trained detectors). On matched essays it does not: 7 of 9 detectors flag English learners significantly less often than native speakers, and none flags them more often. A light grammar correction by a language model raises false flags for every detector (up to 57 times for English learners' essays), while a dictionary spellcheck barely changes them.
